description: The main working tree contains one current state only. For every course, AI question building uses every file recursively under Lecture or 01_Lectures, including nested files regardless of names such as Exercise, homework, review, or additional documents; the only exam-source exclusion is a real filename identifying Week 0 or Week 0.x. AI builds the maximum number of genuinely distinct Lecture-supported semantic blueprints without a fixed quota, while the shared runtime persistently prevents semantic repetition across refreshes, tabs, and browser sessions and stops before repeating when no unseen semantic blueprint remains.
